evidence: Modifies `test/functional/mempool_reorg.py`, which tests mempool transaction persistence and trickle relay behavior across chain reorganizations.
rationale: Refactors `mempool_reorg.py` to use framework helpers on a single node without changing mempool policy or adding new test coverage.
